prompts.name: boy-walk.png
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production JRPG game sprite atlas. Style: coherent warm painterly hand-painted chibi JRPG characters, clean dark brown outlines, softly shaded rounded forms, glossy expressive brown eyes, gentle warm highlights, restrained detail that reads clearly at game scale. Elevated 3/4 top-down game camera, 2-heads-tall chibi proportions. Flat uniform pure chroma-key magenta #FF00FF background everywhere outside subjects. No scenery, no detached ground shadows, no shadows on the background, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no logos, no watermarks. Every whole body is fully contained in its own cell, including feet, hands, headgear and accessories. Consistent scale, ample clean magenta gutters, character center on each cell center, no overlapping cells.
Subject: one friendly Korean elementary-age boy adventurer, short tousled dark brown hair, rounded friendly face, cream safari cap with small green leaf in brown hat band, teal-green explorer vest over cream short-sleeved shirt, matching green neckerchief, tan shorts, cream socks, brown ankle boots, small brown explorer backpack. Cheerful age-appropriate friendly game hero. Preserve that exact costume, cap, hair, face, and backpack in every frame.
Exact 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 whole-body sprites, square sheet ideally 1536x1536. Frames row-major: row 1: east/right walking step A, east/right walking step B, southeast/toward-bottom-right walking step A, southeast/toward-bottom-right walking step B. Row 2: south/toward-viewer step A, south/toward-viewer step B, southwest/toward-bottom-left step A, southwest/toward-bottom-left step B. Row 3: west/left step A, west/left step B, northwest/away-top-left step A, northwest/away-top-left step B. Row 4: north/away-back-view step A, north/away-back-view step B, northeast/away-top-right step A, northeast/away-top-right step B. Each adjacent A/B pair must have visibly opposite legs forward and opposite arms forward, as a two-frame walking cycle, not two duplicated still poses. North views show character back; south views show face. Identity and costume are identical across all 16 views. Keep all sprites on uniform feet baselines within their cells, each occupying about 70 percent of cell height.

Exact landscape 4 columns by 2 rows sheet, exactly 8 sprites, ideally 1536x768. Eight distinct friendly adult local residents of a rural Korean town, all in the same chibi game style, elevated three-quarter full-body static standing view facing slightly toward viewer, one character centered in each equal square cell with feet baseline consistent and about 72 percent cell height. Row 1 left to right: female police officer in neat sky-blue and navy uniform and navy cap, hands relaxed, no weapon; male firefighter wearing clean yellow protective uniform and helmet in a calm non-emergency setting, hands relaxed; elderly woman village storyteller with gray bun, glasses, purple cardigan and comfortable long skirt holding a small closed storybook; male forest guide with olive ranger cap, green vest and tan trousers holding a rolled map. Row 2 left to right: female birdwatcher in a beige field hat, teal vest and outdoor trousers with binoculars worn around neck; male farmer in straw hat, cream shirt, blue overalls and brown boots holding a small basket of vegetables; female market vendor with dark hair in bun, coral blouse and cream apron holding a small basket of fruit; male rail station attendant in navy uniform and peaked cap holding a small timetable board with blank surface. No writing on books, uniforms, badges, board or hats. All adults with distinct faces, hairstyles and outfit silhouettes. No extra people, no outdoor scenery. Keep all hands and all props visually attached to their character.

final_background_edit: Replace the background and contaminated edge pixels with fully opaque #FF00FF. Preserve character identity, every pose and the exact grid. Do not add objects.
